title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #11

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Who was John the Baptist's mother? (1 mark)
   A. Sarah
   B. Elizabeth
   C. Mary
   D. Anna

2. Why should a child tell a trusted adult if someone touches them wrongly? (1 mark)
   A. For no reason
   B. To boast
   C. It is not their fault and the adult can protect them
   D. To get someone in trouble

3. Whom did Joseph credit for the interpretation? (1 mark)
   A. The cupbearer
   B. Himself
   C. God
   D. The magicians

4. According to Genesis 1:27, human beings were created in the what of God? (1 mark)
   A. Shadow
   B. Name only
   C. Voice only
   D. Image

5. What did Jesus say to the woman? (1 mark)
   A. Follow me
   B. Give me water
   C. Don't cry
   D. Go home

6. What causes joy among the angels of God, according to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. A new building
   B. One sinner who repents
   C. A large crowd
   D. A rich person giving

7. What does sharing at school help to build? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Kindness and unity
   C. Selfishness
   D. Jealousy

8. To whom was Mary engaged to be married? (1 mark)
   A. David
   B. Joseph
   C. Simeon
   D. Zechariah

9. The Lord's Prayer can be grouped into praise, provision, pardon and protection. Which idea is about forgiving and being forgiven? (1 mark)
   A. Protection
   B. Pardon
   C. Praise
   D. Provision

10. Who was told about the birth of Jesus in a dream? (1 mark)
   A. Herod
   B. Joseph
   C. Zechariah
   D. Pilate

11. Who is included in the nuclear family? (1 mark)
   A. Cousins and aunts only
   B. Neighbours
   C. Only grandparents
   D. Parents and their children

12. What came upon the disciples at Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. A storm only
   B. An army
   C. The Holy Spirit
   D. A king

13. Which is a way of keeping a uniform in good condition? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving it in mud
   B. Lending it out
   C. Washing and mending it
   D. Tearing it

14. What kind of life did Zechariah and Elizabeth lead? (1 mark)
   A. Wicked
   B. Lazy
   C. Selfish
   D. Righteous before God

15. Which of these helps God's kingdom grow? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping quiet
   B. A good example and sharing the good news
   C. Being unkind
   D. Ignoring church

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain what it means to repent as taught in Acts 2:38 and how a child can do it. (5 marks)

17. Explain the meaning of the word disciple. (2 marks)

18. Describe what happened on the road when Balaam was riding his donkey. (4 marks)

19. Explain what the story teaches about the power of Jesus and His care for people. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Elizabeth
   Elizabeth was Zechariah's wife.

2. C — It is not their fault and the adult can protect them
   Telling keeps children safe.

3. C — God
   Joseph said, "God will give Pharaoh the answer."

4. D — Image
   Genesis 1:27 says that God created human beings in His own image.

5. C — Don't cry
   Luke 7:13 records these words.

6. B — One sinner who repents
   Luke 15:10 says this.

7. B — Kindness and unity
   Sharing builds love and friendship.

8. B — Joseph
   Mary was engaged to Joseph of the house of David.

9. B — Pardon
   Pardon means forgiveness.

10. B — Joseph
   Matthew 1:20 says an angel appeared to Joseph in a dream.

11. D — Parents and their children
   The nuclear family is the small group of parents and children living together.

12. C — The Holy Spirit
   Acts 2 tells of the Holy Spirit.

13. C — Washing and mending it
   Good care extends its life.

14. D — Righteous before God
   Luke 1:6 says both were righteous.

15. B — A good example and sharing the good news
   We help by our life and words.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Repent means to be sorry for sin and turn away from it. Peter told people to repent and be baptised. A child can admit wrong, tell God sorry, ask forgiveness from others, make a decision to do better and ask the Holy Spirit's help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for Acts 2:38, 1 for admitting, 1 for saying sorry, 1 for deciding to do better.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: A follower and learner of Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for follower and 1 for learner.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: The angel stood in the road. The donkey turned into a field and Balaam struck her. Then she pressed against a wall and crushed his foot, and he struck her again. Then she lay down and he struck her a third time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the angel, 1 for turning aside, 1 for the wall and foot, 1 for lying down.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Jesus has power over death. He cares for the poor and lonely, such as widows. He acts out of compassion. People recognised God at work.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.
